name: Fairview Lake YMCA Camps
description_short: YMCA overnight camp on Fairview Lake outside Newton for campers entering grades 2 to 11. Traditional camps (coed Minisink and Tupelo, boys' Kittatinny, girls' Laurel Ridge) live in cabins and choose daily land and lake activities; Ranch, Specialty, Adventure Trip and CIT programs run on the same property.
notes: Traditional camps: Minisink (coed, grades 2 to 4, one, two or three weeks), Kittatinny (boys, grades 5 to 10, three weeks), Laurel Ridge (girls, grades 5 to 10, three weeks) and Tupelo (coed, grades 5 to 10, two weeks). Ranch Camp and Specialty Camps take grades 4 to 10, Adventure Trips grades 4 to 11, and CIT is a six week program for rising juniors; their prices are on their own pages and are not recorded here. Cabins have bunks, electricity and bathrooms. The camp says the registration portal has the most accurate pricing.
